title: v2.logistics.batch_update_tpf_warehouse_tracking_status
label: SHOPEE · API REFERENCE
html:
For CB orders that fulfilled by 3PF, support 3PF Warehouse Vendors to update the tpf_tracking_status when 3PF warehouse receive the order and complete the outbound of the package. CB orders that fulfilled by 3PF： v2.shop.get_shop_info - shop_fulfillment_flag in {Pure - 3PF Shop,PFF - 3PF Shop,LFF Hybrid Shop} And v2.order.get_order_detail - fulfillment_flag = fulfilled_by_local_seller

Request

Request Address

POST/api/v2/logistics/batch_update_tpf_warehouse_tracking_status

Base URL: https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/batch_update_tpf_warehouse_tracking_status

Request Parameters

tpf_namestringTrueShopee 3PF<p>The name of 3PF Warehouse Vendor. Prohibit pure numbers and excessive abbreviations. Standardize naming for easy business recognition. Input priority: warehouse English name > full pinyin of warehouse brand name > warehouse Chinese name > other officially recognized and prominent names.</p><br /><br />
